utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — what kind of repair help are you looking for on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly folks who can help with tools or quick fixes — even an extra pair of hands would be great.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, and I’ll ask around for a couple more hands too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Could you bring a screwdriver, some tape, and maybe a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a screwdriver, tape, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, thanks. I might’ve missed a few things—just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a look right now and send you a quick list of anything we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, but I’d want to confirm the list and where everything’s being dropped off before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—let’s get the list and drop-off spot first, then I can help from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, did you want me to bring any tools or just help sort the repair donations?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just help sort the donations, please — I’m still figuring out what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure thing — I’ll help sort the donations. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are bringing in old tools and broken lamps out by the community hall. Seems like a good turnout already.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard the same—sounds like a busy one. If anyone needs a wrench or screwdriver, I’ve got a few they can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll pass it along in case someone shows up missing a tool.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — I can spread the word about the repair drive right away! If you want, I’ll invite a few neighbors and make sure everyone knows where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — please tell everyone to meet at the community center parking lot. I'll have the sign-in table there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks to meet at the community center parking lot and point them to the sign-in table. I’ll spread the word right away!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Kira, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam—can you confirm what time the repair drive starts and where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll check and confirm the start time and drop-off spot for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive notes organized, and I can start lining up what we need. What’s the first thing you want to tackle, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — let’s start with the biggest broken thing first. What needs fixing most urgently?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d say the front gate is the most urgent since it affects everyone coming and going. After that, we should check the leak in the hall and the busted light by the steps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let me know who’s interested, and we can set a clear time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around today and get back to you with names and availability.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—right, I meant to bring that up. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I can use whatever help you’ve got, even if it’s just a little.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can swing by and help sort donations or carry a few things, if that would be useful. Just point me in the right direction and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. Just tell me what you need me to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—just let folks know we’re collecting donations and volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about donations and volunteers for this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive—happy to spread the word. If you want, I can help get a few more neighbors there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—that’d be great. I might show up a little late, but I’ll try to bring a neighbor with me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds great, Dane—come whenever you can, and bring them along!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard all the details yet—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we’ll meet at the community lot at 9, sort the tools, and head out together. If you can, bring gloves and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, 9 at the community lot. I’ll bring gloves and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9, so it doesn’t conflict with school. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 9 on Saturday works for me. I can help spread the word and make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—feels good to pitch in together. Want me to help organize the stuff or spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, could you help spread the word? I’ll start lining up the stuff we need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word around the neighborhood and get people excited to help. Just send me any details you want me to share.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s on the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that’d really help. I just need to check the list and make sure we’ve got the right tools before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, Pia — just let me know when you’ve checked it, and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive locations—where should I drop things off with you?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Drop them off at my porch on Maple Street, and I’ll sort everything by category. If you get a chance, label any fragile items so we can handle them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I'll bring everything to your porch on Maple Street and label anything fragile.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive start collecting donations yet, or are you still setting it up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still setting it up, but I’m checking the details first so we don’t miss anything. I’ll let you know as soon as it starts collecting donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—thanks. Just let me know when it’s ready, and I can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help gather any spare tools, screws, and tape people can donate? That’d really keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll ask around the block for spare tools, screws, and tape and bring whatever I can հավաք?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is the repair drive still going on? I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so I’d love an update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — I’ve seen a few boxes and folks mentioning it around the block. I might’ve missed the latest update, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’m going to ask around and see if there’s a drop-off spot still open.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did you get confirmation on the repair drive details yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not yet, but I’m still checking around. If I hear back, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, please let me know as soon as you get it. I’d rather wait for confirmation than guess.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some decent support around the block. I’m running errands later, so I can check if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Ira. If you can, maybe ask if they still need tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can do that. I’ll ask around and see if they still need tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks, Oren. Could you start by checking the loose railing by the front steps?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll go check the railing by the front steps now.
